extracted.intended_audience: stakeholders and members of the public tracking USDA Federal Register notices and participating in notice-and-comment (e.g., regulated industry, advocacy groups, grant applicants, producers, state/local governments)
extracted.subtask_description: An API/listing page of recent USDA-related Federal Register documents (rules, proposed rules, notices, NOFOs, and guidance) intended to inform the public about regulatory actions and solicit comments or applications. Useful for people preparing comments, applications, or otherwise following USDA rulemaking and administrative actions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) information-collection notice requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, notices announce an agency's intention to request extension, revision, or renewal of a currently approved information collection and seek public comment.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multiple entries on the page follow this pattern (e.g., "In accordance with the Paperwork Reduction Act of 1995, this notice announces the intention... to request an extension for a currently approved information collection"). Practical expectations: the notice must describe the information collection, state whether it is an extension/no change/revision, and solicit comments on burden estimates and collection methods for OMB review.

rubrics_metrics.name: SNAP retailer staple food stocking standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Retailers participating in SNAP must meet minimum staple food stocking requirements; this rule implements a framework to determine distinct staple food varieties and increases the minimum number of staple food varieties a SNAP retailer must carry from three to seven in each of four staple food categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also increases the number of food categories for which at least one perishable variety must be provided from two to three. The rule codifies how distinct varieties are determined and is intended to ensure retailers can effectively serve SNAP participants by offering a wider variety of staple foods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Child Nutrition Program fluid milk options (milkfat requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Allows schools and child/adult care providers participating in Child Nutrition Programs to offer whole and reduced-fat milk to participants two years and older; codifies milkfat requirements following enactment of the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The change removes prior fluid milkfat-content restrictions to restore flexibility to program operators and aligns meal standards with the goals of the Dietary Guidelines for Americans. Applies as a "final rule with comment period."

rubrics_metrics.name: United States Standards for Grades of Nectarines — speckling removal
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposal to revise the U.S. Standards for Grades of Nectarines by removing "speckling" as a type of defect when grading nectarines because speckling is strictly cosmetic and does not affect internal quality or shelf life.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rationale on the page: speckling correlates with higher sugar content; removing speckling as a defect would align grade standards with current market quality levels and provide guidance for effective utilization of the commodity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establishment of salable quantities and allotment percentages for commodity marketing orders
rubrics_metrics.description: Final rule implements committee recommendations to establish salable quantities and allotment percentages for particular commodity classes for a defined marketing year (example: Far West spearmint oil Class 1 and Class 3 for 2025–2026).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such rules set the quantities producers may market and the percentage allocations by class or region; they are used to manage supply and market stability for the specified marketing year per committee/administrative recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: NOFO publication practice and notice location changes
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice of Funding Opportunity (NOFO) announcement for the Distance Learning and Telemedicine Grant Program that states future funding opportunities will only be announced on the Agency website and grants.gov (and not appear in the Federal Register).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and stakeholders should note the change in where NOFOs will be posted and update record-keeping and monitoring practices accordingly; the notice serves as official public notice of the future change in publication location.

rubrics_metrics.name: Administrative site leases regulatory exemption proposal
rubrics_metrics.description: Proposed amendment to Forest Service land use regulations to exempt administrative site leases from regulations for special uses, intending to align Forest Service leasing with private real estate market practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The proposal is a deregulatory action; commenters should evaluate impacts on alignment with private market practices and any resulting changes in leasing administration or access.

rubrics_metrics.name: FSIS revised Food Safety Guideline for Egg Products — compliance assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: FSIS made available a revised Food Safety Guideline for Egg Products containing information to assist plants producing egg products that undergo pasteurization, heat treatment, cooling, freezing, or enzyme-modification in complying with FSIS regulatory requirements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The guideline was updated to address stakeholder questions and include additional scientific information. Plants should consult the guideline for best practices and interpretations to meet regulatory obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Removal of standard of identity (labeling sufficiency)
rubrics_metrics.description: FSIS is removing the standard of identity for a specific canned product (example: canned 'Tripe with Milk'), having determined the existing standard is unnecessary and that labeling requirements are sufficient to prevent misbranding.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Removal is intended to provide greater flexibility for establishments; agencies may rely on labeling rules rather than prescriptive identity standards where appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Information collections for technical program lists and compliance tools
rubrics_metrics.description: Forest Service and other USDA agencies seek renewal/extension of information collections for items such as Qualified Products Lists for fire chemicals, Equal Opportunity Program Delivery Compliance Review Tool, and similar program compliance instruments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These notices signal continuing data requirements for vendors and program participants; stakeholders should review burden estimates and comment if proposed changes affect reporting or qualification procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Record of Decision (ROD) selection criteria for environmental impact statements
rubrics_metrics.description: The ROD announces the Agency's selected preferred alternative (example: selecting an 'Augmentation Wellfield and Groundwater Use Reduction Alternative') based on goals like improving water availability for a refuge and supporting long-term agricultural water management.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RODs reflect consideration of alternatives, adaptive management strategies, and tradeoffs; commenters and litigants may focus on rationale, chosen mitigation, and monitoring commitments described in the ROD.

rubrics_metrics.name: FACA-governed advisory committee establishment and nominations
rubrics_metrics.description: Notice of intent to establish Secure Rural Schools Resource Advisory Committees governed by the Federal Advisory Committee Act (FACA), soliciting nominations and describing committee duration (two years unless renewed).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notices include membership nomination instructions, governance expectations under FACA, and terms of service; potential nominees and stakeholders should follow solicitation procedures and timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory rescission announcements
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices that rescind previously issued determinations or standards (example: rescission of a Final Determination adopting energy efficiency standards for HUD- and USDA-financed housing).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rescission notices explain the immediate effect and may reference prior publications and extensions; interested parties should review implications for compliance timelines and any subsequent rulemaking.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interstate-movement quarantine and information collection for pest prevention
rubrics_metrics.description: Notices (e.g., regarding pale cyst nematode) announce intentions to revise and extend information collections associated with regulations for interstate movement of regulated articles to prevent spread to non-infested areas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such notices describe regulatory controls on movement, reporting and certification requirements, and request comment on proposed changes to information collections and burden estimates.
